values.note: Bear-proof food lockers at each site and bear-proof trash receptacles.

values.note: The two RV-capable sites (001, 007) and tent-only sites 005 and 006 are reservable on recreation.gov at least 4 days ahead; sites 2-4 and 8-14 (all tent or walk-to) are first-come, claimed at the Maroon Bells Welcome Station (staffed 7 a.m.-7 p.m.) on arrival day, and usually full before noon in summer and fall. 'Five day' stay limit (recreation.gov: 4 nights in a rolling 30 days). Reservations must check in at the Welcome Station within 24 hours or the site is forfeited. 2026 reservation season May 22 - Sept 30 (2027: May 28 - Sept 30). Check-out 11 a.m.

note: White River NF (Aspen-Sopris RD) campground in the Maroon Bells Scenic Area, 5 mi southwest of Aspen on Maroon Creek Rd at ~8,460 ft, in aspen and spruce beside Maroon Creek with views up the valley. Campers drive in on a vehicle pass bought at the Maroon Bells Welcome Station. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + catalog: confirmed $15. Added 14 sites (only 2 take RVs: 22 ft and 30 ft), no hookups, vault toilets, no water, $10 car pass, booking (reservable with tent-only first-come sites, 4-day cutoff, 4-night limit, reservation season May 22-Sept 30), fees checked 2026. Note rewritten: marketing prose and 'Not lakefront' replaced with a factual description.
flags: Rig fit (CRITERIA): only ONE site takes a 23-ft rig. Of 14 sites, recreation.gov's catalog allows RVs/trailers at just two: 001 (RV/trailer 22 ft) and 007 (30 ft); the other 12 are tent-only or walk-to. The FS page says only 'RVs and trailers are welcome at the standard sites' with no length.

Phone: stored 877-444-6777 is recreation.gov's reservation line. The campground's district is Aspen-Sopris Ranger District (970) 963-2266 (FS page office contact, Carbondale; also recreation.gov's facility phone). recreation.gov's contact info gives (970) 945-2521, which the Maroon Bells Scenic Area page calls the Supervisor's Office.

Maroon Creek Rd access (visitmaroonbells.com, 2026): 'The Maroon Bells Scenic Area is closed to inbound private vehicles from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM between May 22nd and October 18th'; 'Campgrounds in the Maroon Bells Scenic Area are managed by the US Forest Service. Those with campground reservations do not need a reservation to park at the Maroon Lake Trailhead.'; 'Starting November 10th, the Maroon Creek Road will be closed for the winter season ... until the road reopens, typically on May 15th.' FS: 'Those camping in developed sites in the Maroon Valley must purchase a vehicle pass to drive to their designated campground at the Welcome Station across from the Silver Bar Campground.' Neither says whether campers are exempt from the 8-5 inbound closure. The Welcome Center parking at Aspen Highlands bars oversized vehicles, which concerns day visitors, not campers.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront): recreation.gov and FS both say the campground is 'on the banks of Maroon Creek'. On Esri imagery Maroon Creek (~8-10 m wide, so creekside by size) passes ~10-15 m from tent/walk-to sites 010-012; RV site 007 is ~35-45 m from it behind spruce and RV site 001 ~60 m. The RV sites themselves would not earn creekside.
Pin 39.1428,-106.8953 is ~50 m from the catalog site centroid (5 m from site 014). Fine. The FS point (39.143315,-106.894979) is also on the campground.

Season: no statement of when the campground itself is open (FS defers to 'Dates and pricing listed under Developed Campgrounds', which shows no dates). Left absent; the reservation season is in booking.season.
